ambiguities.review_comment: missing definition; missing comment. Very strange hierachy of omit:Disease is_a omit:Pathologic process is_a omit:Pathological Conditions, Signs and Symptoms is_a omit:Diseases Category is_a omit:Mesh_term is_a bfo:quality. Clearly, this ontology is built on bfo, but a disease can't be a bfo:quality and a process can't be a bfo:quality.
